title: Sheep Shearer (miniquest)
start: Talk to Fred the Farmer, found in his house in Lumbridge, found North of the Lumbridge Market.

items.t: 20 balls of wool (unnoted, can be obtained during the miniquest)

kills.t: None, but watch out for rams.

steps.t: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for work. › 1 It takes all sorts, I suppose. › Accept › 1 Of course! › 1 I'm something of an expert, actually.]
Fred takes the 20 balls of wool.
Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for work. › 1 It takes all sorts, I suppose. › Accept › 1 Of course! › 1 I'm something of an expert, actually.]
Climb-over the stile into the sheep pen west of his house.

sub.t: Alternatively purchase 20 balls of wool from the Grand exchange and continue to the last step.
You cannot shear black sheep, rams or the odd-looking sheep. If you attack a ram and cannot kill it, run out of the pen until it stops targeting you.

steps.t: Wait 12 seconds for their wool to grow back, shearing them again.
Repeat this process until you have 20 pieces of wool.
Head to the floor 2 of the Lumbridge Castle.
Use the spinning wheel in the southern room to spin the balls of wool.
p: Spinning the wool in Lumbridge Castle.
The two penguins disguised as a sheep.

steps.t: Talk to Fred and hand them in. [Chat: 1 I have some balls of wool for you.]
